title: Implement and test truncate helper
acceptance_criterion: truncate returns unchanged strings at or below max length, returns a string of exactly max characters including an ellipsis when truncating, handles empty input, and rejects non-string input with TypeError.
deterministic_validity_check: node --input-type=module -e "import { truncate } from './src/truncate.js'; if (truncate('hello', 5) !== 'hello' || truncate('hello', 4) !== 'h...' || truncate('hello', 4).length !== 4 || truncate('', 1) !== '') throw new Error('truncate boundary behavior failed'); try { truncate(1, 4); throw new Error('missing TypeError') } catch (error) { if (!(error instanceof TypeError)) throw error }"
patch_requirements: Create src/truncate.js with no imports from other helpers.
Create test/truncate.test.js covering unchanged, truncated, exact-boundary, empty, and non-string TypeError cases.
